verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP registry, hosting and gateway platform, so documented framework and SDK adapters are a fair question. The evidence only shows pre-filled config blocks for desktop and IDE clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code) and a generic gateway endpoint for agents. Nothing documents adapters or integration guides for the Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs.
